source: source.j / source.w3a / source.w3t / source.w3u; custom_v1 game ability defaults
status: Static script audit complete for item-specific runtime handlers; no in-game execution performed. Direct abilities and recipes are integrated separately by the main audit.

effects: Suppresses enemy non-item spellcasting across the map for 120 seconds. Native silence radius 99999; refreshed every 0.25 seconds with 0.6-second buff. Newly spawned/revived or dispelled enemies are affected again on the next pulse.

Repeated use by the same player refreshes their 120-second timer. Different players have independent timers; cleanup removes buffs only when no opposing source remains. Item abilities bypass the script guard.
items.tooltip_correction: Name and text must describe Global Silence rather than Scroll of the Beast.

effects: Applies a 90-second Sleep to a nonhero enemy; Sleep invulnerability field is also 90 seconds.
Removes ACmi spell immunity before the cast; restores ACmi only for unit types n01P and n00U.

Selects non-enemies within 500 of the target point and attempts level-2 A06B invisibility: 55 seconds on normal units, 50 seconds on heroes. Organic allied/neutral ground and air target filter applies.
items.tooltip_correction: Use 500 radius, 55 seconds normal / 50 seconds heroes.

effects: Gives living allied nonmechanical, nonstructure, non-magic-immune units within 1000 +150% movement speed and +150% attack speed for 20 seconds; damage-taken bonus is 0%.
Separately heals eligible allied organic units within 600 for 200 HP through a dummy item. No mana restoration.
Removes the scroll on cast, regardless of remaining displayed charges. Starts A07C cooldown for 25 seconds on the caster.
items.tooltip_correction: One use; 1000 radius frenzy, +150% movement/+150% attack for 20s, plus 200 HP heal within 600.

effects: Attempts to remove dead nonhero nonstructure corpses within 800 of the target point.
items.tooltip_correction: Describe corpse-removal attempt with implementation caveat; do not promise reliable removal.
items.qualification: The GroupEnum filter uses GetEnumUnit() rather than GetFilterUnit(). Its result depends on unrelated enumeration context; intended corpse cleanup is not reliable from static analysis. Gameplay code is unchanged.

effects: Randomly selects up to 26 non-enemy units within 400 of the target point and attempts Anti-Magic Shell on each. Shell lasts 40 seconds and has a 200 spell-damage absorption field.
items.tooltip_correction: Use up to 26 units, 400 radius, 200 spell damage for 40 seconds.

effects: Selects non-enemies within 600 of the target point and attempts Inner Fire: +5% attack damage and +1 armor for 60 seconds.
Selects non-enemies within 400 of the target point and uses dummy Wand of Illusion I023 on each. I023 inherits AIil: 60-second illusion, 0% outgoing damage and 200% incoming damage.
items.tooltip_correction: Use 400 radius and 60-second harmless illusions taking 200% damage.

effects: Creates one o002 Healing Ward of the Gods for 90 seconds: 4000 HP, 75 fortified armor. Regeneration aura heals 30% maximum HP per second within 1600, targeting organic ground/air allies and neutrals.
items.tooltip_correction: Use 90-second duration, 30% maximum HP/s within 1600; ward 4000 HP and 75 fortified armor.

effects: On an attack-start event by a hero carrying Forked Fury against a nonstructure, non-magic-immune target, rolls 1..16; 3,7,12,15 trigger (25%). Requires A0HZ cooldown expired.
Proc casts ACfl forked lightning for 250 damage to up to 8 targets; 900 cast range, 945 maximum length, 400 maximum spread, 165 area field. Starts a 10-second A0HZ cooldown.
items.tooltip_correction: 25% chance on starting an attack, 250 damage to up to 8 targets, 10-second cooldown.
items.qualification: Trigger uses EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ATTACKED, so proc does not require attack damage to land.

effects: Whenever a unit already carrying buff B00L is attacked, a dummy casts A06R Frost Nova: 0 primary and 0 area damage; 175 radius and 1-second normal/hero slow duration.
items.qualification: This supplementary trigger checks the target buff, not whether the attacker currently carries Orb of Frost. Direct AIob cold values remain separate.

effects: Constructs the selected wall orientation. After construction completes, wall lives for 40 seconds.
Wall taunt orders enemy units within 550 to attack the wall.
items.tooltip_correction: Wall duration is 40 seconds; taunt radius 550.

effects: AIil cast-finish handler checks whether the caster carries rat6 (Forked Fury). If so, kills all nonhero units owned by that player with the caster's unit type.
items.qualification: This anti-illusion handler matches AIil, not custom A0PP. It does not expressly test IsUnitIllusion; it kills matching nonheroes.

effects: Casting A08I also creates a dummy Flame Strike A08H at the target point: 350 radius, 17 full damage per 0.1-second interval, 2-second full-damage duration; 10 half damage per 0.25-second interval with 4-second duration field; building damage factor 0.1; maximum-damage cap 0.
Dummy exists for 5 seconds. Ground enemies and neutrals only.
items.tooltip_correction: Include triggered Flame Strike using actual interval/duration values, not the old prose damage total.

effects: Pickup automatically uses the Tome of Power only below hero level 18. At level 18 or above the item is dropped. Nonhero purchases are replaced with a ground item.
items.tooltip_correction: Cannot be used at level 18 or above.

effects: Nonhero purchases are removed from the buyer and recreated on the ground. Packhorses cannot pick this up; an attempted pickup within integer distance 200 removes the ground item.
Nonhero purchases are removed from the buyer and recreated on the ground. Packhorses cannot pick this up; an attempted pickup within integer distance 200 removes the ground item.

unbound_handlers.effect: Thunderfury Staff selects A0QN purge for enemies (450 triggered normal/normal damage plus 1000 summoned-unit damage; 5s normal/1s hero duration) or A0QE for friends. No item has A0QM in its iabi list.

Interchange swaps caster and target positions and starts 60-second cooldown. I01D pickup preserves player timer, but I01D currently has no A0DA in its ability list; do not list this as a Ring of Titans cast ability.
Starts 5-second A0EH cooldown on all allied heroes; belongs to starting I01C, not shop sror.

qualifications: Target enumeration is followed by the native ability target filter and casting rules; a selected unit is not guaranteed a successful native cast.
